name: lykia
description: Lykia: the agent and stablecoin desk built on Arc Network. Lyko keeps the flock inside the Fence.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @lykia/core && npm run build -w @lykia/sdk && npm run build -w @lykia/widget -w @lykia/embed -w @lykia/agent-tools
scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @lykia/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @lykia/web
scripts.verify: npm run build:packages && npm run test:packages && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:api && npm run test:web && npm run build:web && npm run build -w @lykia/api && npm run test:examples
